name: doi_isbn_validate
description: Validate and normalise bibliographic identifiers: DOI syntax (bare, doi: or doi.org URL, with the resolver URL and Crossref-pattern warning), ISBN-10 and ISBN-13 check digits with conversion both ways, ISSN check digit with its EAN-13, and ISMN (979-0 and legacy M- forms). Hyphens, spaces and labels are accepted; the type is detected automatically or given. One value or a list.

issue.description: Issue/variant digits of the ISSN's EAN-13

catalog.source: ISO 2108 (ISBN) check digits as in the ISBN Users' Manual (International ISBN Agency); ISO 3297 (ISSN) mod-11 check digit and the GS1 977 EAN-13; ISO 10957 (ISMN); ISO 26324 and the DOI Handbook (DOI syntax); Crossref's recommended DOI pattern
